original_requirement: CR-04 requires a mandatory K1-K9 falsification gate with exact kill states and a blocking rule.
V2_defect: K1-K9 had generic fields but no per-test frozen kill or partial-overlap criteria; high-significance could be assigned after evidence.
scientific_risk: Post-hoc criteria can convert an unresolved threat into a survival verdict.
exact_required_change: Define and freeze separate K1-K9 criteria before evidence evaluation; require every row to resolve or block final adjudication.
residual_risk: Full-text access and human review remain external dependencies.

original_requirement: HI-06 requires a worker DAG with exclusive responsibility, allowed/forbidden inference and reconciliation ownership.
V2_defect: Worker contracts lacked allowed_inference, forbidden_inference, must_not_conclude and reconciliation_owner; W04 Flash/Sol ownership was ambiguous.
scientific_risk: Extraction workers could make implicit scientific judgments or disagreements could be silently resolved.
exact_required_change: Add the complete contract to W01-W12, separate W04 extraction from Sol reconciliation, and assign reconciliation and QA owners.
residual_risk: A worker disagreement still requires the named human review gate.

original_requirement: HI-08 requires concrete output schemas, threshold freeze and causal-evidence controls.
V2_defect: Threat and red-team artifacts were named without schemas; threshold freeze lacked validity/breakdown boundary and data-timing fields.
scientific_risk: Threats may remain prose-only and thresholds may be chosen after validation data are visible.
exact_required_change: Add concrete threat, red-team, search-log, threshold and clearance schemas and hard-gate validation.
residual_risk: Future execution may expose additional source-specific fields, which require versioned schema changes.

original_requirement: ME-05 requires a structured red-team matrix integrated with K1-K9.
V2_defect: D1_RED_TEAM_MATRIX was named but had no row schema or machine acceptance rule.
scientific_risk: Red-team attacks could remain prose and be omitted from final synthesis.
exact_required_change: Add the required red-team row schema and require S14/S16 to consume and validate it.
residual_risk: Additional attack modes may be recorded under OTHER.

original_requirement: D1-A2 requires machine-checkable human-review clearance and contradiction statuses.
V2_defect: Human review had a record but no sign_off_status/blocking predicate; contradiction status vocabulary was not enumerated.
scientific_risk: A downstream stage could proceed while a required review or contradiction remains open.
exact_required_change: Add D1_HUMAN_REVIEW_CLEARANCE, enumerated contradiction statuses and hard blocking logic.
residual_risk: The workflow remains blocked if a reviewer is unavailable.

original_requirement: Search decisions must be persistently auditable.
V2_defect: Search-record fields existed but no named D1_SEARCH_DECISION_LOG deliverable was required.
scientific_risk: Search triggers, closure and bias controls could be lost in worker output.
exact_required_change: Add D1_SEARCH_DECISION_LOG to S10 outputs, worker W10 contract and S16 package validation.
residual_risk: Broad search remains prohibited; only named triggers may create rows.

original_requirement: Claim transitions should be machine-linked to complete evidence packets.
V2_defect: The transition schema relied on provenance_pointer without a dedicated packet ID field.
scientific_risk: Packet-level reconciliation could require manual pointer interpretation.
exact_required_change: Add evidence_packet_ids to the V3 claim-transition contract and validate IDs.
residual_risk: Unavailable packets remain explicitly marked UNAVAILABLE.
